about: Always-on listing characters per shipped plugin (#1881). The gate fails when a plugin's count grows; lower it with --write after a drop. est_tokens = chars / 3.0.

cli_cross_check.note: The CLI counts commands with disable-model-invocation: true (pipeline's deploy-cloud, ~80 tok), which the skills docs say are not in context; and it adds a per-component overhead this estimate does not. The ratchet is on characters, so the gap does not affect pass/fail.
